groups.heading: Sclerosing angiomatoid nodular transformation (SANT)
points: Multiple coalescing angiomatoid nodules separated by concentric fibrosclerotic / myofibroblastic stroma
Triphasic immunophenotype: CD34+/CD31+/CD8- capillaries, CD34-/CD31+/CD8+ sinusoids, CD34-/CD31+/CD8- small veins
Benign; distinguish from hamartoma, littoral cell angioma and inflammatory pseudotumour

images.caption: SANT — gross stellate fibrotic mass and coalescing angiomatoid nodules in dense collagenous stroma (H&E).
images.credit: Pelizzo et al., Case Rep Surg 2018 (PMC5964553), Fig 3

images.caption: SANT — immunohistochemical comparison showing the distinct vascular phenotype of lesional nodules vs adjacent splenic red pulp.
images.credit: Pelizzo et al., Case Rep Surg 2018 (PMC5964553), Fig 4

groups.heading: Littoral cell angioma (LCA)
points: Anastomosing blood-filled vascular channels with papillary fronds lined by tall plump endothelial cells
Sloughed histiocyte-like cells in lumina with haemophagocytosis / haemosiderin
Dual endothelial–histiocytic phenotype: CD31+, ERG+, CD68+, CD163+, CD21+; characteristically CD8- and CD34-

images.caption: Littoral cell angioma — anastomosing vascular channels with papillary projections (H&E, intermediate mag).
Littoral cell angioma — plump lining cells with bland nuclei and intraluminal exfoliated cells (H&E, high mag).

groups.heading: Splenic hamartoma
points: Unencapsulated mass composed of disorganised red pulp elements (slit-like sinusoids and cords) lacking organised white pulp follicles
Sinusoidal lining retains normal splenic littoral phenotype: CD8+, CD31+, Factor VIII+, CD34-

images.caption: Splenic hamartoma — disorganised red pulp sinusoids without normal white pulp architecture (H&E, intermediate mag).

groups.heading: Primary splenic angiosarcoma
points: Destructive, irregular anastomosing vascular channels and solid spindle/epithelioid sheets with marked nuclear atypia, mitoses and necrosis
Expresses at least two vascular markers (CD31+, ERG+, CD34+/-, Factor VIII+); variable CD68/CD8

images.caption: Primary splenic angiosarcoma — imaging and histopathology showing atypical vasoformative/spindle proliferation and endothelial IHC.

groups.heading: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma & EBV+ inflammatory FDC sarcoma
points: Spindle-to-ovoid cells in fascicles, storiform arrays or whorls with indistinct borders and admixed small lymphocytes/plasma cells
Positive for FDC markers CD21, CD23 and CD35 (often D2-40/clusterin+)
EBV-positive inflammatory FDC sarcoma (WHO-HAEM5): strong EBER ISH positivity in neoplastic spindle cells with prominent lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate

images.caption: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma — syncytial spindle/ovoid tumour cells with vesicular nuclei and admixed lymphocytes (H&E, high mag).
Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma — diffuse strong CD23 immunoreactivity highlighting dendritic meshwork.

groups.heading: Splenic cysts & reactive changes
points: Epithelial (primary) cyst: fibrous trabeculated wall lined by stratified squamous (epidermoid) and/or cuboidal mesothelial epithelium (CK+, calretinin/WT1 in mesothelial areas)
Gamna–Gandy bodies: fibro-siderotic nodules encrusted with iron and calcium in congestive splenomegaly / portal hypertension
Hyaloserositis (sugar-coated spleen): dense hyalinised paucicellular collagenous capsular plaques

images.caption: Primary splenic epithelial cyst — cuboidal epithelium transitioning to stratified squamous metaplasia over a fibrous wall (H&E).
images.credit: Daga et al., J Indian Assoc Pediatr Surg 2011 (PMC3047768), Fig 2

images.caption: Gamna–Gandy bodies — encrusted iron- and calcium-laden fibrous nodules with haemosiderin pigment (H&E).
images.credit: Bhatt S, Simon R, Dogra VS (Wikimedia Commons)

images.caption: Splenic hyaloserositis — dense hyalinised fibrous capsular thickening ('sugar-coated' spleen, H&E).

snippets.label: SANT triphasic immunophenotype note
snippets.text: Sclerosing angiomatoid nodular transformation (SANT) is a benign vascular lesion of the spleen characterised by coalescing angiomatoid nodules containing three distinct vessel types (CD34+/CD31+/CD8- capillaries, CD34-/CD31+/CD8+ sinusoids and CD34-/CD31+/CD8- small veins); splenectomy is curative.

snippets.label: Littoral cell angioma note
snippets.text: Littoral cell angioma is a benign splenic vascular neoplasm with a dual endothelial and histiocytic immunophenotype (CD31+, CD68+, CD163+, CD21+, CD8-, CD34-). Clinical follow-up is occasionally recommended because of reported associations with visceral malignancies and immune-mediated disorders.

snippets.label: EBV+ inflammatory FDC sarcoma note
snippets.text: EBV-positive inflammatory follicular dendritic cell sarcoma (WHO-HAEM5) is an indolent stroma-derived neoplasm of the spleen and liver; complete excision is usually curative, though local recurrence may occur.

snippets.label: Primary splenic angiosarcoma note
snippets.text: Primary splenic angiosarcoma is an aggressive malignant vascular neoplasm with a high risk of distant metastasis and spontaneous rupture; multidisciplinary oncology review is recommended.
